workouts.title: Week Overview
workouts.description:
Welcome to week 2 of the fitness phase. This week you will notice the gymnastics focus on Mon-Wed, Weightlifting focus on Tue and a hybrid focus on Friday. Make sure to hit the high intensity pieces hard with all you have and the longer volume pieces with consistency and amazing technique.
Have fun :)
